race.title: Download The Matchbook App Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
race.verdict: WISE MAIDEN made a winning Rules debut in good style in an Aintree bumper in May, travelling strongly before going on to score by 9½ lengths, and she can pick up where she left off to defy a penalty. Point winner Chicks For Free has joined a yard amongst the winners and isn't taken lightly, with Mariah's Dream completing the shortlist. WISE MAIDEN CHICKS FOR FREE (IRE) MARIAH'S DREAM
